scope: Current source path/hash verification after full-length Vorbis BGM conversion. Atlas geometry/alpha results retained only because the eight source PNG hashes remain unchanged.

shared_ground_projection.logical_rules: Rules retain integer logical cells; presentation uses the shared projected ground coordinates.

unused_embedded_art: game-skin-atlas bottom slider and knob without region entries

data_thumbnail_dependencies.note: Referenced by the three level JSON thumbnail fields; preserve them even though current play UI does not render them.

package.policy: Current complete source only; standard ZIP without .godot, movies, screenshots, old concepts or archives. Package hashes are external to avoid self-reference.

warnings.detail: Some alpha>=128 pixels touch this crop boundary, although the substantial silhouette is fully retained. Keep filter_clip enabled and visually inspect smallest display sizes.

methodology: Resource literals inspected across scripts, scenes, project settings and level JSON; bounded game/settings atlas and validation-01..03 expressions expanded.
Every original RGBA crop is measured. Substantial silhouettes are connected alpha>=128 regions larger than 100 pixels; no such intersecting component is clipped. Source rectangles do not overlap.

The 14 current ant/bead/audio slices each contain one alpha>=4 connected silhouette larger than 100 pixels, with exactly seven source pixels on each side. Boundary alpha is below 4. This is not an equal-grid crop.

Foot-anchor measurement applies actual KEEP_ASPECT_CENTERED sizing to the current ground_ant source rectangle and measures the bottom alpha>=128 baseline relative to the group origin; contact shadow is local (0,0).
Main and playable bead placement, carrier route coordinates and FX cell points use BoardPlane. Rules retain integer logical coordinates.
Runtime AtlasTexture constructors enable filter_clip. Imports disable mipmaps and enable fix_alpha_border.
No full rendered-scene visual acceptance, gameplay/input regression test, or device performance approval is claimed by a source audit.
